features.title: Convert to PDF
features.detail: Word, Excel, PowerPoint, RTF, text, HTML, Markdown, XPS, Visio and Publisher

notes.windows: Also DjVu, CHM, OpenDocument text, spreadsheets, presentations and Draw, email and EPUB, with conversion diagnostics. The conversion workbench also writes Word from Markdown, HTML, RTF and ODT, and converts between Office and OpenDocument. It converts CBZ, CB7, stored RAR5 CBR, FB2, FB2.ZIP and unencrypted MOBI, PalmDOC PDB and AZW3 to PDF. The reader supports stored records and PalmDOC compression.
notes.linux: Also DjVu, CHM, OpenDocument text, spreadsheets, presentations and Draw, email and EPUB, with conversion diagnostics. The conversion workbench also writes Word from Markdown, HTML, RTF and ODT, and converts between Office and OpenDocument. It converts CBZ, CB7, stored RAR5 CBR, FB2, FB2.ZIP and unencrypted MOBI, PalmDOC PDB and AZW3 to PDF. The reader supports stored records and PalmDOC compression.
